[d0074] config | ingress.log_level | version 4.x
# `ingress.log_level`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Log verbosity of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `error` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | ingress |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `ingress.log_level` only if you observe problems with the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[ingress]
log_level = "error"
```

[d0779] config | partitioner.log_level | version 4.x
# `partitioner.log_level`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Log verbosity of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `info` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | partitioner |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.log_level` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
log_level = "info"
```

response.content: `ingress.log_level` controls the verbosity of logs from the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST. It accepts `debug`, `info`, `warn`, or `error`; the 4.x default is `error`.
